Inline, internal and external CSS

CSS can be applied through an element’s style attribute, a style element in the HTML head, or a
linked external stylesheet.
CSS කියන්Jන් HTML elements වල Jපෙනුම පොලනය කරන භාෂාවකේ. Inline CSS එක element එකටම
ලියනවා. Internal CSS එක page එක ඇතුJළේ style tag එකක ලියනවා. External CSS file එක pages

Interview question: Which CSS approach is most maintainable for multiple pages?
Answer: External stylesheets, because the same rules can be reused and maintained separately.
Practice: Create two pages that link to one CSS file.
